main_body: A hospital bed with a barred headboard (rows 11-20) and a white pillow, sheet and blue blanket (rows 22-42), ending in a thin footboard frame (rows 43-46).
top_band: No distinct top band. Rows 11-12 are a thin light cap (L 215/170) above the headboard bars. Rows 22-42 are a near-white sheet slab (L about 230-255) seen flat from above, with no front face below it.
evidence: The headboard is a flat front elevation: its vertical bars are painted on the face under a 1-2px cap. The bed itself is a top-down plan, with a pillow, sheet and blue blanket stacked as a 21-row flat slab. No foreshortened top band is followed by a front edge line, an eave shadow or a visible south face. The only front is a 3-4 row frame at rows 43-46, and the main body is not a real 3/4 volume. Mixed top-down and front-elevation parts, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. 99% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line instead of a tinted material tone. Shading is shallow: the sheet uses a few whites and greys, and the blanket has only 2-3 blues. There is no tile or grain texture, though the 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0% and the colours per tile (13) are comparable. It looks thinner and more sticker-like than the stall and well references.
